business_problem: After opening a new stadium, Texas Rangers needed to fill the seats and engage with fans to keep them coming back. Behind the scenes, manual guest service processes and data silos created operational inefficiencies and made it difficult to grow revenue.
solution_summary: After opening a new stadium, the Texas Rangers used Salesforce to replace siloed operations data with a unified, real-time view of sales, service, and game-day activity. Sales Cloud routes and prioritizes ticket leads, including interest-form submissions from fans browsing the team website, so reps can follow up faster on demand signals. Service Cloud replaced manual guest-services tracking, giving agents a live case workflow for issues raised around the ballpark and making those cases visible to other teams that need to respond. Tableau then turns the combined sales, guest-service, concession, event, and promotional data into dashboards that staff use across 81 home games to spot operational bottlenecks, adjust resources, and improve the fan experience. Because the club now works from one source of truth, it can make action-based decisions in real time, raise ticket revenue, and follow through on fan issues with more context than before.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores account, opportunity, and workflow data teams use to unify operational, guest-service, and ticketing data for game-day decisions.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores cases, knowledge, and service context that supports teams as they unify operational, guest-service, and ticketing data for game-day decisions.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Provides dashboards and analytics teams use while they unify operational, guest-service, and ticketing data for game-day decisions.
